programs.name: Medicine
programs.description: Six-year medical program (Staatsexamen) at Germany's oldest university. Clinical training at University Hospital Heidelberg (one of Germany's top medical centers). Extremely competitive with very high Numerus Clausus.

programs.name: Physics
programs.description: Study of theoretical and experimental physics at one of Europe's leading physics departments. Excellent research facilities and connections to Max Planck Institutes. Specializations in quantum physics, astrophysics, and condensed matter.

programs.name: Chemistry
programs.description: Organic, inorganic, physical, and analytical chemistry. Modern labs in the Chemistry Institute. Good preparation for pharma and chemical industry careers.
entryRequirements: Chemistry and Mathematics at secondary level

programs.name: English and American Studies
programs.description: Study of English literature, linguistics, and cultural studies. Taught in English with native-speaker faculty. Strong tradition in philology and cultural studies.

programs.name: Applied Computer Science
programs.description: Practical and applied computer science covering software engineering, databases, and IT systems. English-taught with German cultural experience in the historic city of Heidelberg.

programs.name: Molecular Biotechnology
programs.description: Focus on molecular biology, gene technology, and pharmaceutical biotechnology. Heidelberg has Germany's leading life sciences research cluster (BioScience).
